title: Service deployment conformance
description: Per-service status of every service deployment workflow step, as last recorded by Collect Service Conformance (the only writer). Plan 15; change service-deployment-workflow task 7.5.

panels.title: Current failed step states
panels.description: Count of unique service and step pairs whose newest state in the last 45 minutes is fail. This is current recorded state, not a count of new failure events. When valid inventory markers exist but no step is currently failed, the fallback returns one unlabeled zero; with no recent inventory marker (no valid marker within 45 minutes) the panel shows No recent data.

targets.expr: sum(last_over_time({job="agent-cloud-conformance", step!="none"} | json state_code | unwrap state_code | __error__="" [45m]) by (service, step) == bool 0) or (sum(last_over_time({job="agent-cloud-conformance", step="none", status=~"^(no_history|has_history|history_incomplete)$"} | json | inventory_code=~"^(0|1|2)$" | marker_time_seconds=~"^[0-9]+$" | __error__="" | unwrap inventory_code | __error__="" [45m]) by (service) * 0))

panels.title: Services tracked

targets.expr: count(count by (service) (count_over_time({job="agent-cloud-conformance", step="none", status=~"^(no_history|has_history|history_incomplete)$"} | json | inventory_code=~"^(0|1|2)$" | marker_time_seconds=~"^[0-9]+$" | __error__="" [45m])))

panels.description: Distinct services with a valid inventory marker in the last 45 minutes, including services with no workflow history. Invalid marker bodies are excluded. No valid marker means no data.

panels.title: Latest inventory marker age

targets.expr: min(last_over_time({job="agent-cloud-conformance", step="none", status=~"^(no_history|has_history|history_incomplete)$"} | json | inventory_code=~"^(0|1|2)$" | marker_time_seconds=~"^[0-9]+$" | __error__="" | label_format age_seconds=`{{sub (unixEpoch now) .marker_time_seconds}}` | unwrap age_seconds | __error__="" [45m]))

panels.description: Age in seconds of the newest valid collector inventory marker, calculated from its numeric body timestamp. The 30-minute stale threshold is calibrated from 12 successful collector runs on 2026-10-10 (11.7–11.9-minute task durations; 14.8–15.1-minute completion gaps). Recalibrate from future run receipts; this is not a lifetime timing guarantee. No valid marker within 45 minutes is unavailable, not zero.

panels.title: Services not yet run
panels.description: Inventoried services whose newest valid collector marker reports no workflow history. No matching rows means no service currently reports no history; no valid marker remains no data.

targets.expr: last_over_time({job="agent-cloud-conformance", step="none", status=~"^(no_history|has_history|history_incomplete)$"} | json | inventory_code=~"^(0|1|2)$" | marker_time_seconds=~"^[0-9]+$" | __error__="" | unwrap inventory_code | __error__="" [45m]) by (service) == 0

panels.title: Latest step status by service
panels.description: One row per service and workflow step. State is the newest report in the last 45 minutes and is shown as fail, pass, or skip. The collector re-emits retained state, so a recent collection gap does not erase the latest pass, fail, or skip. An empty result means no step state was reported in that window. Services that have not run any step are listed in "Services not yet run", not here. Error and task context appears separately in historical failed task snapshots; those snapshots can repeat across collector runs and are not joined to these current rows.

targets.expr: last_over_time({job="agent-cloud-conformance", step!="none"} | json state_code | unwrap state_code | __error__="" [45m]) by (service, step)

panels.title: Recent failed task snapshots
panels.description: Failed task records received during the selected dashboard time range, including the error and Semaphore task id. The collector can repeat the same historical failure in later snapshots, so these rows are not new-event counts and may not match the latest state above. Use the task id to identify the workflow run.

panels.title: History incomplete
panels.description: Services whose workflow history the collector could not read in full: a template's history filled the 1000-task window, so a step missing here may be older, not absent. NetBox keeps that step's last recorded status.

targets.expr: last_over_time({job="agent-cloud-conformance", step="none", status=~"^(no_history|has_history|history_incomplete)$"} | json | inventory_code=~"^(0|1|2)$" | marker_time_seconds=~"^[0-9]+$" | __error__="" | unwrap inventory_code | __error__="" [45m]) by (service) == 2
